name: Sentakuya Shin-chan
source:
Shin works at the family business, that is Laundry with an express delivery in wich he is the best, and the work is raising each time, the business is actually increasing due to the lonely womans ask deliveries because they want Shin to make them feel happy for some time.

[Taken from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=8054]ANN[/url]]
translation:
慎在家族经营的洗衣店工作，最擅长快速送货上门。工作量不断增加，生意也日益兴隆，因为许多孤独女性会要求送货，只为让慎暂时带给她们快乐。

[摘自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=8054]ANN[/url]]
